name: Sail Shade Dubai
headline: Sail Shade Dubai
lede: Shading Solutions: Shade Dubai is a wholly owned UAE company with professional experience in the design and manufacture sun shade range.
services: So what are you waiting for ?
about: Shade Dubai shade cloths are made for the great outdoors. Our knitted fabric is designed and constructed to allow airflow to keep you cooler. SHADE DUBAI shade cloth is strong, durable and resistant to tearing and rotting. We also provide a weather-proof variety which is also water-resistant for those rainy days of every year in UAE from January till end of March.
